title: This AI data centre promised no Colorado River water. Now it wants 260mn gallons
description: Deemed as the largest AI data centre in the state, the 330-megawatt unit earlier promised to not use water from Colorado River. But now, the developer behind the project is suing for access to the river water which is already a threatened source of freshwater for 40 million people and the centre of countless disputes over water use in West.

title: Taylor Swift, Travis Kelce's $2m gift moves families of fallen NYC heroes
description: Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce's generosity has brought heartfelt reactions from families of fallen New York City heroes who have long relied on Answer The Call for support. Widows and children shared emotional messages, with one saying, "I am in tears," while thanking the couple for their kindness. The donation is part of the couple's wider charitable efforts ahead of their wedding, but what touched these families most was the reassurance that the sacrifices of their loved ones will never be forgotten thanks to the couple's $2 million gift.

title: A single tree can make 9 million seeds - and it's invading Queensland
description: An ornamental tree planted in Tahiti in 1937 now poses a serious biosecurity threat. This invasive miconia species aggressively invades forests and smothers native vegetation. A single mature tree can produce millions of seeds, rapidly spreading across landscapes. Queensland's World Heritage rainforests face irreversible ecological damage from this plant. Early detection and eradication efforts are crucial to protect these precious ecosystems.
